# Public Cap

> NCAA Power 4 money desk: annual capacity from public filings versus the House benefits cap versus booked NIL.

Public Cap is the college athletics capacity desk at https://thepubliccap.com. It covers the Power 4 plus Notre Dame (68 schools). Pending stays empty. The desk does not invent House or NIL dollars. Collective 990 payout is a separate cited lane, not House. Reported football NIL is a survey range or labeled modeled conference band — not booked NIL and not a midpoint.

## Pages

- Home: https://thepubliccap.com/ — rank list, capacity vs House cap vs booked NIL
- Methods: https://thepubliccap.com/methods — how the desk books capacity, House, booked NIL, and collective 990 payouts
- School pages: https://thepubliccap.com/school/<slug> — one page per school (examples: /school/lsu, /school/notre-dame)
- Compare: https://thepubliccap.com/compare
- Reported NIL: https://thepubliccap.com/reported-nil
- NIL 101: https://thepubliccap.com/nil-101 — plain-English guide to how college athletes get paid
- TV: https://thepubliccap.com/tv — conference TV contracts and school media checks when a filing exists
- Tape: https://thepubliccap.com/tape
- Buyout: https://thepubliccap.com/buyout
- Coach buyout offsets: https://thepubliccap.com/coach-fa
- Guarantee games: https://thepubliccap.com/guarantee-games
- Checkbook bowl: https://thepubliccap.com/checkbook-bowl — did the bigger football spender win the big game?

## Crawlers

- Sitemap: https://thepubliccap.com/sitemap.xml
- Empty or pending cells are not zero
